description_en: Invokes the BandwidthPackageAddAccelerator operation to attach a bandwidth plan to an Alibaba Cloud Global Accelerator (GA) instance
description_zh: 调用BandwidthPackageAddAccelerator接口将带宽包与全球加速实例绑定
kebab_example: aliyun ga bandwidth-package-add-accelerator --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --bandwidth-package-id gbwp-bp1sgzldyj6b4q7cx0000 --accelerator-id ga-bp1qe94o52ot4pkfn0000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: BandwidthPackageAddAccelerator

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the Alibaba Cloud Global Accelerator (GA) instance. Set the value to cn-hangzhou
parameters.help_zh: 全球加速实例所在的地域ID，仅取值cn-hangzhou
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the bandwidth plan to attach to the Alibaba Cloud Global Accelerator (GA) instance
parameters.help_zh: 与全球加速实例绑定的带宽包的ID
parameters.name: bandwidth_package_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud Global Accelerator (GA) instance to which the bandwidth plan is attached
parameters.help_zh: 与带宽包绑定的全球加速实例的ID
parameters.name: accelerator_id

Accelerators.description_en: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud Global Accelerator (GA) instance to which the bandwidth plan is attached
Accelerators.description_zh: 与带宽包绑定的全球加速实例的ID

items.description_zh: 与带宽包绑定的全球加速实例的ID
